tests.scenario: Successful Workout Logging Without Crash
steps: Open the workout logging screen
Enter valid workout details (type, duration, distance)
Press the Submit button
tests.expected_result: The workout is saved successfully, a confirmation message is displayed, and the application remains fully operational.

tests.scenario: Logging Workout Under Low Memory Conditions
steps: Simulate a low device memory environment
Open the workout logging screen
Enter workout details and press Submit
tests.expected_result: The application does not crash under low memory conditions and the workout is saved successfully.

tests.scenario: Data Restoration After Crash Mid-Entry
steps: Open the workout logging screen
Enter partial workout details
Simulate an application crash
Relaunch the application
tests.expected_result: The application restores the partially entered workout data and prompts the user to review and save it.

tests.scenario: Data Restoration After Crash on Submission
steps: Open the workout logging screen
Enter complete workout details
Simulate a crash at the exact moment of submission
Relaunch the application
tests.expected_result: All workout data is fully restored and the user is prompted to confirm before the entry is permanently saved.

tests.scenario: Workout Syncs to Second Device Within 60 Seconds
steps: Log a workout on Device A while connected to Wi-Fi
Ensure Device B is linked to the same user account
Enable network connection on Device B
Wait up to 60 seconds and check workout history on Device B
tests.expected_result: The workout logged on Device A appears on Device B within 60 seconds with no duplication or data loss.

tests.scenario: No Duplicate Entries After Multiple Sync Attempts
steps: Log a workout on Device A
Trigger a manual sync three times in succession on Device B
Review the workout history on Device B
tests.expected_result: Only one instance of the workout appears in the history on Device B with no duplicate entries created.

tests.scenario: Sync Failure Notification on Network Error
steps: Log a workout on the device
Disable the network connection to simulate failure
Trigger a sync operation
Observe the notification displayed
tests.expected_result: A descriptive error notification appears within 5 seconds citing the network failure reason and showing a Retry Sync button.

tests.scenario: Retry Sync Button Restores Data After Network Recovery
steps: Trigger a sync failure by disabling the network
Observe the error notification with Retry Sync button
Re-enable the network connection
Press the Retry Sync button
tests.expected_result: The sync completes successfully after pressing Retry Sync and the workout data appears on all linked devices.

tests.scenario: GPS Signal Acquired Within 30 Seconds Outdoors
steps: Stand outdoors with clear sky visibility
Open the app and navigate to the outdoor activity screen
Press the Start Activity button
Measure the time until a GPS confirmation indicator appears
tests.expected_result: A GPS signal is acquired and the confirmation indicator is displayed within 30 seconds of pressing Start Activity.

tests.scenario: GPS Acquisition Warning When Signal Unavailable
steps: Open the app in an area with no GPS signal (e.g. indoors)
Navigate to the outdoor activity screen
Press the Start Activity button
Wait 30 seconds and observe application behaviour
tests.expected_result: If GPS signal cannot be acquired within 30 seconds, the application displays a clear warning message and does not begin recording inaccurate route data.

tests.scenario: GPS Distance Accuracy Within 2% on Known Route
steps: Run a pre-measured route of exactly 5.00 km
Enable GPS tracking before starting the run
Complete the route and stop the activity
Compare the app-recorded distance to 5.00 km
tests.expected_result: The app-recorded distance is between 4.90 km and 5.10 km, confirming accuracy within the 2% tolerance threshold.

tests.scenario: GPS Distance Accuracy in Dense Urban Environment
steps: Run a pre-measured urban route of 3.00 km
Enable GPS tracking and complete the route
Compare app-recorded distance to 3.00 km
tests.expected_result: The app-recorded distance is between 2.94 km and 3.06 km even under urban GPS interference conditions.

tests.scenario: Workout Shared to Community Feed in Under 10 Seconds
steps: Complete and save a workout
Navigate to the workout summary screen
Select Share Workout and choose the in-app community feed
Measure the time taken for the post to appear
tests.expected_result: The workout summary is posted to the community feed within 10 seconds and a confirmation notification is shown.

tests.scenario: Workout Sharing Fails Gracefully Without Network
steps: Complete and save a workout
Disable the network connection
Attempt to share the workout to the community feed
tests.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the share failed due to no network, and offers a retry option without posting duplicate content.

tests.scenario: Leaderboard Refreshes Automatically After 5 Minutes
steps: Open the community leaderboard screen
Record the current rankings and timestamp
Wait 5 minutes without manual interaction
Observe the leaderboard for an automatic update
tests.expected_result: The leaderboard updates automatically within 5 minutes and displays an updated last-refreshed timestamp.

tests.scenario: Leaderboard Timestamp Reflects Correct Refresh Time
steps: Open the community leaderboard screen
Note the displayed last-refreshed timestamp
Wait for an automatic refresh to occur
Verify the new timestamp matches the actual refresh time
tests.expected_result: The displayed last-refreshed timestamp updates accurately to reflect the exact time of the most recent data refresh.

tests.scenario: Itemised Billing Screen Shown Before Subscription Payment
steps: Navigate to the subscription selection screen
Select a subscription tier
Proceed to the payment confirmation step
Inspect the confirmation screen content
tests.expected_result: The confirmation screen displays the plan name, billing cycle, total charge amount, and next renewal date before any payment is processed.

tests.scenario: Payment Not Processed Without Explicit User Confirmation
steps: Navigate to the subscription payment confirmation screen
Close the screen without confirming
Check the user's billing history
tests.expected_result: No charge is applied to the user's payment method when the confirmation screen is dismissed without explicit approval.

tests.scenario: Subscription Cancelled Immediately on User Request
steps: Navigate to the subscription management screen
Select Cancel Subscription and confirm the action
Check subscription status immediately after confirmation
tests.expected_result: The subscription is terminated immediately upon confirmation, a cancellation notification is delivered within 60 seconds, and the subscription status shows as cancelled.

tests.scenario: No Further Charges After Subscription Cancellation
steps: Cancel an active subscription
Wait for the next scheduled billing date to pass
Check the user's billing history for new charges
tests.expected_result: No new charges appear on the user's billing history after the subscription cancellation date.

tests.scenario: All Subscription Tiers Displayed in Comparative Layout
steps: Navigate to the subscription selection screen
Inspect the layout of the subscription options
tests.expected_result: All available subscription tiers are displayed side-by-side with each tier listing its price, billing cycle, and an itemised list of included features on a single screen.

tests.scenario: Subscription Comparison Screen Accessible from Settings
steps: Open the application settings menu
Navigate to the subscription management section
Select View Plans or equivalent option
tests.expected_result: The subscription comparison screen loads successfully and displays all tiers with accurate pricing and feature details.

tests.scenario: User Successfully Creates a Group Fitness Challenge
steps: Navigate to the challenges section
Select Create Challenge
Enter challenge parameters: name, duration, activity type, and maximum participant limit
Submit the challenge creation form
tests.expected_result: The challenge is created without errors and appears in the user's active challenges list within 10 seconds.

tests.scenario: User Successfully Joins an Existing Group Challenge
steps: Navigate to the challenges section
Select Join Challenge
Browse the available challenges list
Select an open challenge and confirm joining
tests.expected_result: The user is added to the selected challenge without errors and the challenge appears in the user's active challenges list within 10 seconds.
